title: Phrases that calm Dad
intro: Short, warm phrases for the moments that come up most. Keep your voice low and slow, and use Dad's name.

phrases.text: I'm right here. Let's have some tea while we wait.
phrases.when: When the question comes from worry, not from missing facts

phrases.text: I'm sorry this is hard. I'm with you.

phrases.when: When a worry is shared, even if it doesn't make sense to you

phrases.text: Let's do it together, one step at a time.
phrases.when: When a task feels too big

phrases.text: We have plenty of time. I'll let you know when it's time.
phrases.when: When the same question about plans or time comes up again

footer: Use these in your own words, in a calm and slow voice.
